app.name: Yoga for beginners | Prayoga
app.description: A yoga app for beginners that uses on-device body tracking technology to give real-time feedback as you perform asanas and poses.

verdict.one_liner: Prayoga does not sell your data and offers a 30-day retention limit, but it allows third-party advertisers to track your app activity with cookies and may transfer your data in a business sale.
verdict.summary: Prayoga's actual privacy policy (a Termly-generated template) reveals data practices that go beyond the App Store's 'Data Not Collected' label. The app requests camera and storage permissions, shares data with third-party vendors and advertisers who use tracking cookies, and reserves the right to transfer data in a merger or acquisition. On the positive side, the developer caps data retention at 30 days, promises Apple Health data is never used for marketing, offers a data-deletion request form, and says it will notify users of material policy changes.
verdict.recommendation_reason: The 30-day data retention cap and explicit promise not to use Apple Health data for marketing are strong positives. However, the presence of third-party advertising trackers and business-transfer clauses means privacy-conscious users should review their settings.

red.title: Third-party advertisers track you with cookies
red.plain_english: Prayoga allows selected third-party advertising companies to place tracking technology on the app so they can collect data about how you interact with it and show you targeted ads.

red.title: Data may transfer in a sale or merger
red.plain_english: If Prayoga is sold, merges with another company, or is acquired, your personal information may be transferred to the new owner as part of the deal.

red.title: Do-Not-Track signals are ignored
red.plain_english: Prayoga explicitly says it does not respond to Do-Not-Track browser signals, meaning your request not to be tracked online is not honoured.

red.title: Camera and storage permissions requested
red.plain_english: The app asks for access to your camera and device storage. While this may be for body tracking, the policy does not clearly limit what data is accessed beyond these permissions.

green.title: Data kept for maximum 30 days only
green.plain_english: Prayoga promises to keep your personal information for no longer than 30 days, which is one of the shortest retention periods we have seen in any app.

green.title: Apple Health data never used for ads
green.plain_english: Prayoga explicitly promises that Apple HealthKit data is used only for health and fitness services, and never for marketing, advertising, or data mining — even by third parties.

green.title: Data deletion request form available
green.plain_english: You can submit a request form to review, update, or delete your personal information, and Prayoga promises to respond within 30 days.

green.title: Material policy changes are notified
green.plain_english: If Prayoga makes important changes to its privacy policy, it says it will either post a prominent notice or send you a direct notification.

green.title: Does not sell or rent your information
green.plain_english: Prayoga states it does not share, sell, rent, or trade your information with third parties for their promotional purposes.

categories.label: Device Info & Fingerprinting
categories.plain_english: Prayoga says it may collect information regarding your mobile device when you use the app, and third-party trackers may collect interaction data over time.
categories.detail: Mobile device information collected. Third-party tracking technology enables data collection about app interactions over time, which implies device identification.
categories.policy_excerpt: We may collect information regarding your mobile device, when you use our apps... selected third parties to use tracking technology on the Apps, which will enable them to collect data about how you interact with the Apps over time

categories.label: Health & Biometric Data
categories.plain_english: Prayoga uses Apple HealthKit and motion/fitness tracking for yoga and health services. It explicitly promises this data is never used for marketing, advertising, or data mining.
categories.detail: Apple HealthKit, Motion and Fitness tracking used. Heart rate samples during workouts collected. Explicit promise: never used for marketing, advertising, or data mining — including by third parties. Data only used for smart routines and personal charts.
categories.policy_excerpt: We use Apple HealthKit framework to only provide health, motion or fitness services with connection to the app. It is never used for marketing, advertising or use based data mining, including by third parties... Activity, performance and workout data, such as heart rate samples during a workout, are also collected by the Application. This data is only used to create smart routines for you, provide charts and summaries for you to understand your health and fitness journey better and never shared with anybody outside the application.

categories.label: Financial & Payment Data
categories.plain_english: The privacy policy does not mention any collection of payment or financial data by Prayoga itself. Payment processing is handled by third-party providers.
categories.detail: Payment processing mentioned as an example of third-party vendor service, implying Prayoga does not handle payments directly.

categories.label: Data Deletion & User Rights
categories.plain_english: You can submit a request form to review, update, or delete your personal information, and Prayoga promises to respond within 30 days. Data is kept for no longer than 30 days unless required by law.
categories.detail: Data request form available. 30-day retention cap. 30-day response promise. Data deleted or anonymized when no longer needed.
categories.policy_excerpt: No purpose in this policy will require us keeping your personal information for longer than 30 days... To request to review, update, or delete your personal information, please submit a request form by clicking here. We will respond to your request within 30 days.
concerns: Anonymization fallback if deletion not possible

categories.label: Policy Change Notification
categories.plain_english: Prayoga may update its privacy notice from time to time. For material changes, it says it will either post a prominent notice or send a direct notification.
categories.detail: Updates indicated by 'Revised' date. Material changes notified by prominent posting or direct notification. Users encouraged to review frequently.
categories.policy_excerpt: If we make material changes to this privacy notice, we may notify you either by prominently posting a notice of such changes or by directly sending you a notification.
concerns: Non-material changes may not be notified
